name: Sigil (dev, UNAUDITED)
description: Pre-audit development build of the Sigil authenticator. Do NOT store real 2FA secrets.
_comment_host_permissions: LOOPBACK ONLY. The dev Sync panel talks to a local sigild op-log; MV3 extension pages need an explicit host permission to fetch cross-origin. Deliberately scoped to localhost so this build can never reach a remote server.
_comment_key: PUBLIC key only (no private half exists in this repo). It pins the unpacked extension ID to pfjbkipclodhghopppjjgnlbhkmhlekp so the headless test can address chrome-extension://<id>/... deterministically without a background service worker. Not a secret; not a signing key.
